MUTUAL.title: Bolt grade markings and strength chart
MUTUAL.note: Distributor. SAE J429 grades 2/5/8 (Grade 2 printed as ranges, both size bands in one cell, so not recorded per band), ISO 898-1 classes without a size split (8.8 printed once: 800 / 640 / proof 600, recorded under d <= 16). No hardness, no A574.

BOSSARD.title: Technical sheet F-013: marking and mechanical properties of hex head fasteners UNC/UNF according to SAE J429; marking according to ISO 898-1 (revision April 2009)
BOSSARD.note: Fastener maker and distributor. SAE J429 grades 1, 2, 5, 5.2, 8 with size ranges; proof, yield and tensile in psi and MPa. Grade 1 has no grade mark. Parts with reduced loadability are marked with a leading 0 (04.6, 010.9).

WESTFIELD.title: Strength specifications of metric threaded fasteners
WESTFIELD.note: Distributor. Classes 4.6, 4.8, 5.8, 8.8 (16 mm and under / 17-72 mm), 9.8, 10.9, 12.9: proof strength, yield min, tensile min (MPa). Prints the 8.8 proof strengths as 660 (16 mm and under) and 580 (over 16), not in the order Optimas prints.

OPTIMAS.title: Mechanical and physical properties of steel fasteners (EN ISO 898-1)
OPTIMAS.note: Fastener distributor. ISO 898-1 property table: Sp, ReL / Rp0.2 / Rpf, Rm, HV, HB, HR. The 8.8 columns are not labelled on the page; the split is read as d <= 16 / d > 16 from the value order.

MSC.title: Socket head cap screws (socket products handbook: inch 1960 series and metric, pp. 1-16)
MSC.note: Distributor PDF, maker not named. Inch: ASME B18.3 and ASTM A574 (tensile 180,000 psi #2 to 1/2, 170,000 psi over 1/2; yield 162,000 / 153,000; HRC 39 / 37 min). Metric: ASME B18.3.1M and ASTM A574M head and key sizes and minimum tensile loads; drill and counterbore tables (inch p. 5, metric p. 12). The inch head columns came out garbled, so only the hex key column is used. Metric M3 row prints body diameter 2.50 (misprint).

AFT.title: Socket cap screws: dimensions and mechanical properties (ASME B18.3-2003)
AFT.note: Distributor. Inch socket head cap screws #0 to 1 1/2: head diameter and height max/min, hex socket. Alloy steel hardness HRC 39 min (0 to 1/2), HRC 37 min (5/8 and larger).

AMFAST.title: Socket products: socket head cap screws
AMFAST.note: Distributor. Inch socket head cap screws #0 to 1 1/2: head diameter max, head height max, hex socket size. No standard named.

MISUMI.title: Metric socket head cap screw dimensions (blog); counterboring and bolt holes for hexagon socket head cap screws (technical data p. 2847, from JIS B 1176); machine keys and key grooves (technical data, from JIS B 1301:1996)
MISUMI.note: Maker and distributor. Head table follows "ISO specifications" (M1.6 to M48). Counterbore table: hole d', counterbore D', depth H' and H'' for M3 to M30. Key table: the PDF text extraction mixed the parallel-key and taper-key hub depths; the values used are the set that matches JIS B 1301 parallel keys (8 x 7: t2 = 3.3). Non-preferred sizes in brackets are left out.

NBK.title: Diameter of clearance holes and counterbores for bolts and screws (excerpt from JIS B 1001:1985, refers to ISO 273)
NBK.note: Maker. Grades 1, 2, 3 (= ISO 273 fine, medium, coarse) and grade 4 (cast holes, not in ISO 273, in brackets, not recorded). Its counterbore D' is a spot face for hex bolts and is not used.

FRACTORY.title: Metric clearance hole sizes
FRACTORY.note: Manufacturing service. Close / normal / loose fit, M1 to M150, no standard named. Prints M3 normal 3.35 and M6 normal 6.5; prints M30 twice (normal 32 and 33).

OPTIMAS_TAP.title: Tapping sizes: ISO metric coarse with close, medium and free fit clearance holes
OPTIMAS_TAP.note: Close / medium / free fit; no standard named.

TRF.title: Tapping sizes and clearance holes
TRF.note: Fastener maker. One metric clearance column (recorded as medium; it matches the NBK grade 2 values); Unified close and free fit as drill names. Stated as recommendations.

WIKI_AF.title: Width across flats
WIKI_AF.note: Table of ISO widths across flats M2 to M42 (credits ISO 262:1998). Text: ISO 272 (1982) changed M10, M12, M14 and M22 from 17, 19, 22 and 32 mm.

ACCU.title: Across flats bolt size and spanner size chart
ACCU.note: Distributor. Metric: separate ISO rows for M10, M12, M14 and M22 (other rows recorded as both ISO and DIN) and a JIS M8 row (12 mm). Inch rows are hex nut sizes (7/16 -> 11/16, 9/16 -> 7/8), not hex cap screw heads; machine-screw rows not recorded (#6 is printed 5/16 with decimal 0.2500).

SLS.title: Spanner selection chart (hex head bolt)
SLS.note: Distributor. Metric DIN and ISO columns M1.6 to M160; inch ASME and BS columns 1/4 to 3 in.

FASTENIT.title: DIN 6885-1 standard dimensions for parallel keys (edition 08/1968, shown as withdrawn on the page)
FASTENIT.note: Fastener standards portal. b x h, shaft range, t1, t2; lengths from its form B weight tables.

AIMS.title: What is a key and keyway? (keyway guide: ANSI B17.1-1967 (R2013), DIN 6885-1 / ISO 773, Woodruff)
AIMS.note: Distributor. Metric table to 170-200 mm. Inch table with square and rectangular keys and shaft keyseat depth (half the key height). Woodruff list without keyseat depths (not used).

EE_KEY.title: Shaft diameter vs key sizes (design per ANSI B17.1)
EE_KEY.note: Engineering reference site. Square and rectangular key width and height, keyseat depth H/2, shafts 5/16 to 11 in.

AMES_KEY.title: Key size versus shaft diameter per ANSI B17.1-1967 (R1998)
AMES_KEY.note: Engineering calculator site. Only the shaft diameter ranges are in the page text (key sizes are in an image), so it confirms the ranges only.

EE_TSLOT.title: Dimension table for T-slots, bolts and nuts (ANSI/ASME B5.1M-1985), mm columns
EE_TSLOT.note: Engineering reference site. Throat width (= slot width a), headspace width and depth min-max in inch and mm; it prints the depth of the throat, not the total slot depth, so h is not taken from it.

ITEH_299.title: ISO 299:1987 Machine tool tables - T-slots and corresponding bolts (preview)
ITEH_299.note: Standards distributor preview. The OCR text is partly garbled; only the clearly readable b, c and h min-max, the bolt thread and the pitches are taken. Slot width tolerance H12 (fixing slots), H8 (reference slots).

GTWEED.title: AS568 O-ring size chart ("O-Ring Seals")
GTWEED.note: Seal maker. Dash numbers -005 to -475 and -901 to -914: ID and CS with tolerances, inch. Prints -391 ID 21.995 where the -471 row of the same step prints 21.955.

EFUNDA.title: O-ring AS568 sizes
EFUNDA.note: Engineering reference site. Detailed rows only for -001 to -050 and -102 to -114.

ORINGSINC.title: AS568A size chart (PDF)
ORINGSINC.note: Distributor. The text extraction lost the alignment of most rows; only rows printed clearly with their dash number are used (about every tenth size).

BOSSARD_F044.title: Technical sheet TF.049 (F-en-2023.05): friction coefficient classes A to E for muG and muK, according to VDI 2230 (2015), room temperature
BOSSARD_F044.note: Fastener maker. The aim is class B for a high preload with little scatter. Descriptions are summarised in BenchMate's words.

HAMEEDI.title: Experimental determination of torque and friction coefficients in the torque-preload relationships of bolted connections, ÉPKO 2025
HAMEEDI.note: Conference paper. Eq. (3): T = Fv [0.16 p + 0.58 mu_t dm + 0.5 mu_h dh], attributed to Motosh and VDI 2230. Measured mean friction 0.13 to 0.44 on M16-M24 structural bolts (dry highest, oiled lowest).

FVA.title: FVA-Workbench 9 documentation: bolt connection (VDI 2230-1:2015, eq. 229-231 and 259)
FVA.note: Software maker. MA = FMzul (0.16 P + 0.58 d2 muGmin + DKm/2 muKmin); FMzul = A0 nu Rp0.2min / sqrt(1 + 3 [3/2 d2/d0 (P/(pi d2) + 1.155 muGmin)]^2), nu normally 0.9.

BOSSARD_VDI.title: Approximate values for metric coarse threads, VDI 2230 (assumptions page)
BOSSARD_VDI.note: Tables based on VDI 2230 (2015), 90 % utilisation of ReL / Rp0.2, clearance holes ISO 273 medium; values are maximums without a safety factor and higher than the 1986 edition.

MAREK.publisher: marek.eu (catalogue technical pages, publisher not named)
MAREK.title: Technical information: screws and nuts, pp. 1287-1288 (VDI 2230 clamping forces and tightening torques)
MAREK.note: Torques computed with muG = muK. Used only as a worked-example check of the torque formula in core/src/fasteners.rs.

GLOBAL_ORING.title: O-ring groove design
GLOBAL_ORING.note: Seal distributor. All compression values between 5 % and 30 % squeeze; static seals typically 15-30 %; dynamic less; design for roughly 60-85 % groove fill, never 100 %; installed stretch max 5 %; rod gland OD compression max 2 %; face seal OD up to 3 % over (internal pressure) or ID up to 5 % under (external pressure).

APPLE.title: Seal design guide: O-ring installation
APPLE.note: Seal maker. Squeeze about 10-40 % static, no more than 30 % dynamic; O-ring volume not over 90 % of the minimum gland void; at least 75 % of the cross-section inside the groove; stretch not over 5 % in the application, not over 100 % while installing.

sae_note: Mutual Screw prints Grade 2 as tensile 60,000-74,000, yield 36,000-57,000 and proof 33,000-55,000 psi in one row: the same two size bands Bossard prints separately.
clearance_metric_note: Fractory prints M30 twice, with normal fit 32 and 33; 32 (the first row) is recorded.
clearance_inch_note: MSC prints close and normal fit as drill name and decimal (the decimal is recorded; its 1 1/4 normal 1.3215 and 1 1/2 normal 1.5825 do not equal the printed fractions 1 5/16 = 1.3125 and 1 9/16 = 1.5625). TR Fastenings prints close and free fit as drill names only; the build looks the decimal up in the drill chart evidence.
af_metric_note: Accu marks only the ISO M10, M12, M14 and M22 rows; its other metric rows are recorded as both ISO and DIN.
keys_inch_note: AIMS lists square keys up to 6 1/2 in shafts only ("not preferred" above); Engineers Edge marks rectangular keys as preferred below that row and square above it, the reverse reading of the same boundary. Engineers Edge footnote: some key standards show 1 1/4 in for the 6 1/2 to 7 1/2 in rectangular height, preferred 1 1/2 in.
